headline: U.S. House Committee Advances Bill to Establish Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
summary: A legislative bill to codify a U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared a committee vote and is now eligible for a full House of Representatives floor vote. The proposal faces a tight legislative deadline.
why: This bill represents a significant potential shift in U.S. fiscal policy regarding digital assets. If passed, it would mandate the government to hold Bitcoin as a reserve asset, impacting market liquidity and institutional adoption.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Government accumulation of an asset typically reduces circulating supply and signals institutional legitimacy.
